intro: A Bloodfeather Belt is a crude leather strap worn by the Bloodfeather harpies infesting northern Teldrassil. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak collects these belts as proof that local nests encroaching on the Oracle Glade have been cleared.

p: The Bloodfeather harpies have nested aggressively in the boughs around the Oracle Glade, threatening the ancient Oracle Tree and choking travel through northern Teldrassil. When a runner carrying reports to Darnassus was ambushed and slain by the flock, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak called on travelers to strike back directly at their nests. Taking the belts from fallen harpies serves as tangible proof that their numbers are being culled, securing the paths so communication with the capital can resume.
